# RAND Corporation

> > Nonprofit institution providing research and analysis to the U.S. military and public welfare, covering defense, artificial intelligence, space cooperation, homeland security, and global policy.

RAND Corporation conducts policy research across defense, technology, health, and international relations, with particular focus on U.S.-Japan cooperation, Indo-Pacific security, AI applications, and space exploration. The organization operates RAND Australia, the Pardee Graduate School, and maintains research divisions including Homeland Security Research Division (HSRD).

## Key Topics

- Defense Research
- Artificial Intelligence
- U.S.-Japan Relations
- Indo-Pacific Security
- Space Cooperation
- Homeland Security
- Veterans Policy
- China Policy
- Ukraine Conflict
- JAXA Partnership
- Artemis Program
- COVID-19 Response
- Climate Resilience
- Military Will to Fight
- Belt and Road Initiative

## About RAND

- [RAND Australia](https://www.rand.org/australia.html): RAND Australia Canberra subsidiary for defense and policy research
- [RAND Alumni](https://www.rand.org/alumni.html): Alumni community page featuring Crawford Impact Award and engagement
- [RAND Australia Staff](https://www.rand.org/australia/about/staff.html): RAND Australia staff directory in Canberra office
- [HSRD Leadership](https://www.rand.org/hsrd/about/leadership.html): Homeland Security Research Division leadership team directory
- [FAQs (Arabic)](https://www.rand.org/ar/about/faqs.html): Arabic FAQ page about RAND organization and FFRDCs

## Events and Webinars

- [Events](https://www.rand.org/events.html): Main events listing page for RAND conferences and webinars
- [RAND Air and Space Force Research Forum](https://www.rand.org/events/2023/05/11.html): Air and Space Force research forum covering logistics and Indo-Pacific
- [The Future of Space Cooperation Between the U.S. and Japan](https://www.rand.org/events/2022/03/7-8.html): U.S.-Japan space cooperation conference featuring JAXA and Artemis program
- [The Impact of the War in Ukraine on the Indo-Pacific Region](https://www.rand.org/events/2022/09/us-japan.html): U.S.-Japan event with Admiral Harris on Ukraine's Indo-Pacific impact
- [China's AI Exports](https://www.rand.org/events/2023/12/chinas-ai-export.html): Webinar on China's AI exports dataset covering Belt and Road Initiative
- [AI Risks and Benefits in Clinical Care](https://www.rand.org/events/2025/02/ai-risks-and-benefits-in-clinical-care.html): RAND Health webinar on AI applications in clinical care and imaging
- [A Conversation on Catastrophic Incentives](https://www.rand.org/events/2024/09/catastrophic-incentives.html): Webinar on disaster preparedness with Columbia Climate School experts
- [Twenty Years of Service: American Perspectives on What We Owe Veterans](https://www.rand.org/events/2021/09/30.html): Veterans Policy Research Institute webinar on post-Afghanistan benefits

## Research Publications

- [Reports and Findings on the Will to Fight](https://www.rand.org/ard/projects/will-to-fight/publications.html): Research publications on military will to fight and security assessments
- [Health Research (Arabic)](https://www.rand.org/ar/publications/health.html): Arabic health research page covering COVID-19 and Middle East healthcare
